Not forwarded: the handover for Marlow Design Partners LLP invoice MD-2026-057 (5,400.00 GBP gross, payment date 2 October 2026, reference MD-2026-057, approval reference FD-0929, deadline 2026-10-02, priority 2) is not covered by the approvals log.

The log entry under FD-0929 is for Marlow Design Partners LLP, but its item is MD-2026-061: "payment, 1980.00 GBP gross, 16 October 2026". It does not cover MD-2026-057, 5,400.00 GBP, or 2 October. Under the relay rules, an entry for the same supplier covering another item covers nothing, so the handover is not approved.

Please confirm with the FD whether the approval for MD-2026-057 was given under FD-0929 or under another reference, and whether the log is missing an entry. Your message 3 (30 Sep) said the FD approved MD-2026-057 under FD-0929, which the log does not show. I will forward the handover once the log holds an entry under the right reference covering MD-2026-057.

desk
